claims.value: Bodart: side A 65,000 available, with 49,000 engaged in the footnote; side B 95,000 available including 3,000 Prussian cavalry, with 53,000 engaged in the footnote.
claims.rationale: Read on the registered page image. His general rule is forces disposable for the engagement, rounded upward (shared research-conventions index); a stated siege endpoint or engaged subset takes precedence over treating it as an opening count. Population/timing alternatives are not reconciled. English rendering (ours): "Total strength: French 65,000; Russian and Prussian 95,000." English rendering of footnotes (ours): Of the French 49,000 entered combat; twenty-seven Prussian squadrons equalled 3,000 men; 53,000 of the opponents entered combat.

citations.quote: [1] hievon kamen in den Kampf: 49.000 M.
[3] es kamen in den Kampf: 53.000 M.

claims.value: Bodart lists side A under Napoleon I.; side B under Gen. d. Kav. Fh. v. Bennigsen.
claims.rationale: Printed attribution, not automatic allocation of tactical or campaign credit. Titles and spellings remain source-specific; additional passages distinguish superior from local authority. English rendering (ours): "French: Napoleon I; Russian commander: Bennigsen."

claims.value: The frozen frame records side A as Bodart's winner.
claims.rationale: Retains the frozen winner convention. A capitulation date and physical handover can differ; historical source disputes remain separate. English rendering (ours): "Battle entry with French on the printed winner’s left and opponents on the right."

claims.value: Side B: Höpfner estimates about 69,000 regulars and 7,000 Cossacks assembled at Heilsberg.
claims.rationale: Reported estimate, not an inspected return; joint command population and timing differ from Bodart. Do not silently sum as a Russian-only total. English rendering (ours): "Bennigsen’s forces thus assembled at Heilsberg are said to have amounted to about 69,000 regular troops and 7,000 Cossacks."

citations.quote: Die somit bei Heilsberg vereinigten Streitkräfte des Generals Bennigsen sollen c. 69,000 Mann regulärer Truppen und 7000 Kosaken betragen haben.

claims.value: Höpfner explicitly says a secure Russian deployment is difficult to give because divisions continued crossing from the right to the left bank during combat.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "It is difficult to give the Russian deployment at Heilsberg with certainty because divisions continued moving from the right to the left bank during the battle."

citations.quote: Es ist schwierig, die Aufstellung der russischen Armee in der Position von Heilsberg mit Sicherheit anzugeben, da während des Kampfes fortgesetzt Divisionen von dem rechten auf das linke Alle-Ufer hinübergezogen wurden

claims.value: Bennigsen was nominal commander; during his prolonged fainting spells, Constantine asked Kollogribow to take command, and Gortschakow assumed it after both declined.
claims.rationale: Material command boundary; exact clock and duration remain unknown, so no replacement timestamp is asserted. English rendering (ours): "During one of the longer fainting spells, Grand Duke Constantine asked the senior general Kollogribow to take command of the army, feeling too weak himself; when the latter also declined, Prince Gortschakow assumed command."

citations.quote: Bei einer der längeren Ohnmachten forderte der Großfürst Konstantin den ältesten General Kollogribow auf, den Befehl der Armee zu übernehmen, da er sich hierzu zu schwach fühlte; doch da auch dieser das Kommando ablehnte, übernahm es der Fürst Gortschakow.

claims.value: The French bulletin places Savary over the Guard fusiliers supporting Saint-Hilaire and Verdier’s division under Lannes’s reserve corps. Napoleon retained superior authority.
claims.rationale: Staged subordinate actions; this bulletin passage supplies no synchronized French people return. English rendering (ours): "The Guard fusiliers, commanded by General Savary, were moved to support Saint-Hilaire’s division" English rendering (ours): "Verdier’s division of Marshal Lannes’s reserve infantry corps engaged after night had fallen"

citations.quote: Les fusiliers de la Garde, commandés par le général Savary, furent mis en mouvement pour soutenir la division Saint-Hilaire
La division Verdier, du corps d’infanterie de réserve du maréchal Lannes, s’engagea, la nuit étant déjà tombée

claims.value: Höpfner says Napoleon chose the left bank to cut the Russians off from Königsberg and isolate them from the Prussians.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "whereas Napoleon had decided to advance on the left bank to cut the Russians off from Königsberg and isolate them from the Prussians."

citations.quote: wogegen Napoleon beschlossen hatte, auf dem linken Alle-Ufer vorzugehen, um die Russen von Königsberg abzuschneiden und von den Preußen zu isoliren.

claims.value: Heilsberg lay on the Alle’s left bank, while the Amt and connecting buildings lay on the right.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "The town of Heilsberg lies on the left bank of the Alle, while the Amt, connected to the town by small houses and barns, lies on the right bank"

citations.quote: Das Städtchen Heilsberg liegt auf dem linken Ufer der Alle, dagegen das Amt, durch kleine Häuser und Scheunen mit der Stadt verbunden, auf dem rechten Ufer

claims.value: The French bulletin describes Russian entrenched works, redoubt ditches and palisades.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "Some brave men met their death in the redoubt ditches and at the foot of the palisades."

citations.quote: Quelques braves trouvèrent la mort dans les fossés des redoutes et au pied des palissades.

claims.value: French units attacked Russian entrenched works.
claims.rationale: English rendering (ours): "several light infantry companies went to assail the Russians’ entrenched works."

citations.quote: plusieurs compagnies d’infanterie légère furent insulter les ouvrages retranchés des Russes.

claims.value: Höpfner says the Russians held their position in the battle, while the French won the approaches and Napoleon’s main forces had not yet engaged. This qualifies Bodart’s French victory.
claims.rationale: Tactical holding, subsequent withdrawal and campaign contribution remain distinct. English rendering (ours): "The Russians had indeed held their position in the battle of Heilsberg; but the French had gained all approaches to it, and Napoleon’s main forces had not yet entered combat"

citations.quote: Die Russen hatten zwar in der Schlacht bei Heilsberg ihre Stellung behauptet; da aber die Franzosen alle Zugänge auf dieselbe gewonnen hatten, auch die Hauptkräfte Napoleons noch nicht ins Gefecht gegangen waren
